tagline: Global leader in digital health and cloud-connected medical devices
hero_kpi_rationale: The R&D KPI is chosen as Hero because it reflects the company's investment in research and development (6.4% of net revenue), essential to maintain its leadership in the digital health and connected medical devices sector.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.description: The company invested $331.3 million in research and development in 2025, representing 6.4% of net revenue with focus on innovative product development such as the AirSense 11

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.description: The company's net revenue rose 10% to $5,146.3 million in 2025, driven by higher demand and sales volumes

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin rose to 59.4% in 2025 versus 56.7% in 2024, thanks to efficiency gains in sourcing, manufacturing and logistics

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net Income — bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income rose 37% to $1,400.7 million in 2025 versus $1,021.0 million in 2024, or $9.51 per diluted share

kpis.name: Sleep and Breathing Health Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Sleep and Breathing Health segment.
kpis.description: The Sleep and Breathing Health segment generated $4,504.9 million in 2025, up 10% thanks to higher demand and sales volumes of devices and masks

kpis.name: Devices Revenue
kpis.explanation: Measures revenue from selling respiratory medical devices, showing the commercial health of this key business segment.

kpis.name: Masks & Accessories Revenue
kpis.explanation: Measures mask and respiratory accessory sales revenue. Shows profitability of this key product segment.

kpis.name: Residential Care SaaS Revenue
kpis.explanation: Measures revenue from software managing care facilities, showing growth of this key business segment.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Measures the percentage of profit ResMed keeps after paying operating expenses, before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Measures cash available after operating expenses. Shows if ResMed genuinely generates usable profit.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, sourced from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

stories_kpis.name: R&D Investments
stories_kpis.description: The company invested $331.3 million in research and development in 2025, representing 6.4% of net revenue with focus on innovative product development such as the AirSense 11

stories_kpis.name: Net Revenue
stories_kpis.description: Net revenue reached $5,146.3 million in 2025, up 10% versus the prior year, driven by higher demand and sales volumes

ai_positioning.summary: La société RMD ne mentionne pas l'intelligence artificielle (IA) ou l'apprentissage automatique dans son rapport 10-K/20-F.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT incidents
risks.summary: Une cyberattaque pourrait compromettre les données sensibles des patients ou interrompre les opérations critiques.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1A as a major issue. The language stresses board and CISO oversight, with escalation protocols, indicating high severity. The company has an active cyber risk management program, which reinforces the importance of the risk. The Cybersecurity category is weighted heavily here.

risks.title: Litiges et poursuites juridiques
risks.summary: Des poursuites en cours pourraient avoir un impact financier ou réputationnel, bien que jugées non matérielles à ce stade.
risks.score_rationale: Mentionné dans l'Item 3, la société est impliquée dans des litiges courants, mais indique qu'ils n'auront pas d'effet matériel sur les états financiers. Le langage est rassurant, mais le risque existe. Position centrale dans le rapport, mais intensité modérée.

risks.title: Dependence on new technologies
risks.summary: Failure to innovate or to commercialize new solutions could harm competitiveness and growth.
risks.score_rationale: The company invests heavily (6.4% of revenue) in R&D and depends on innovation (e.g. AirSense 11). The risk of development failure or delay is implicit. Although not explicitly framed as a risk, the strategic context makes it critical.

risks.title: Concurrence sur le marché des dispositifs médicaux
risks.summary: La pression concurrentielle pourrait réduire les marges ou limiter la part de marché malgré l'innovation.
risks.score_rationale: Le secteur est décrit comme dynamique et concurrentiel. Bien que non détaillé dans les extraits, le positionnement stratégique et les investissements en R&D suggèrent une pression concurrentielle forte. Risque implicite mais central dans le secteur médical.

risks.title: Growing cybersecurity regulation
risks.summary: Failure to comply with new cybersecurity or data-protection standards could trigger sanctions.
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions tracking of emerging cybersecurity regulations by the CISO and the board. This indicates heightened exposure to legal obligations. The risk is rising with the evolution of the regulatory framework.

governance.voting_structure_note: Single class of common stock, 1 vote per share.
